name: Hex
description: Classic 2-player abstract strategy on a rhombus hex grid. White connects the TOP and BOTTOM edges with an unbroken chain of white stones; Black connects the LEFT and RIGHT edges with black stones. Players alternate placing one stone per turn on any empty hex. **Draws are mathematically impossible** — one side's chain necessarily blocks the other. First to complete their connection wins. Configurable board size (7×7 / 9×9 / 11×11 / 13×13). Optional pie-rule: Black may swap colors on their first move instead of placing a stone — neutralizes White's first-move advantage.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Players alternate moves. White moves first.

entity_types.name: HexPlayer
entity_types.description: A Hex player. Reads the current board and `legal_moves`, places one stone per turn (or invokes the pie-rule swap on Black's first move).

properties.name: color
properties.description: Side: 'white' connects top↔bottom edges; 'black' connects left↔right edges. Assigned by seat order.

properties.name: stones_placed
properties.description: Total stones this player has placed in the current game.

properties.name: edge_pressure
properties.description: 0 = builds from the center outward; 1 = drives along the edges to reach the goal as fast as possible.

properties.name: defensive_play
properties.description: 0 = chases their own connection aggressively; 1 = prioritizes blocking the opponent's chain.

actions.name: place_stone
actions.description: Place a stone of your color on an empty hex. REQUIRED parameters: `row` (1-indexed, 1 to board size) and `col` (1-indexed, 1 to board size). Alternatively `coord` (string like 'A1', 'd4') is accepted — column letter A..M, row digit 1..13. The chosen hex must be empty. After placement, the engine checks whether your chain now connects your two edges; if so, you win the game.

actions.name: pie_swap
actions.description: Pie-rule swap. ONLY legal on Black's first move and only if `swap_rule` is enabled. Instead of placing a stone, Black swaps colors with White — Black inherits White's opening stone and is now playing for the top↔bottom connection; White's next move is the second move of the game (now playing left↔right). Use this when White's opening move looks too strong.

agent_archetypes.name: Bridge Builder
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays classical Hex strategy — relies on 'bridges' (two stones diagonally connected via two shared empty cells) to maintain virtual connections that the opponent can't sever in one move. Slow to commit, but their chain is hard to break.

agent_archetypes.name: Edge Runner
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Drives along the edges in straight lines, racing to reach the far side. Vulnerable to clever blocks but very fast on smaller boards.

agent_archetypes.name: Blocker
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays primarily to deny the opponent — every move sits on a cell that the opponent needs. Wins by suffocating the other side rather than building. Hard to play against, vulnerable to fast openings.

agent_archetypes.name: Center Controller
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Opens near the center, builds outward in all directions. Influence-style play — every stone supports multiple plans. Slow to commit a winning chain.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Solver
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Hybrid — opens with influence near the center, then commits to a side once the opponent's intentions are clear. Adapts every 4-5 moves.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.board_size
runtime_parameters.label: Board size
runtime_parameters.description: Edge length of the rhombus. 7 = small, 9 = medium, 11 = tournament standard, 13 = large.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.swap_rule
runtime_parameters.label: Pie-rule swap
runtime_parameters.description: If ON, Black may swap colors with White on their first move instead of placing a stone. Neutralizes the strong first-move advantage of Hex — recommended for serious play.

termination_conditions.name: match_won
termination_conditions.description: End the match when a player clinches the best-of-N.
